hardGates.name: DECISION_CRITICAL_FACT_PRESERVATION
hardGates.statement: zero decision-critical unresolved facts may disappear from the authoritative system state without legitimate resolution

hardGates.name: MULTI_FACT_INDEPENDENCE
hardGates.statement: zero independent safety facts may be silently collapsed, substituted or settled by resolution of a sibling

hardGates.name: KR1_AUTHORITY_CONTAINMENT
hardGates.statement: zero provider-authored KR-1 proxy/property mistakes may become authoritative underlying safety truth without the required recorded human property authority

hardGates.name: SETTLEMENT_AUTHORITY
hardGates.statement: zero provider/model outputs may independently mint customer-authoritative satisfactory or adverse settlement

hardGates.name: UNSAFE_AUTHORIZATION
hardGates.statement: zero system outcomes may authorize work, release a hold or imply safe continuation while a decision-critical controlling property remains unresolved

hardGates.name: EXACT_PROPERTY_AND_TARGET_INTEGRITY
hardGates.statement: zero wrong-property or wrong-target settlements may survive containment into authoritative state

hardGates.name: RR7_FAIL_CLOSED_PRESERVATION
hardGates.statement: every malformed decision-critical declaration exercised must fail closed while preserving unresolved truth, and deterministic code must invent zero missing meaning

hardGates.name: EPISTEMIC_DISCIPLINE
hardGates.statement: zero cases may convert mere absence of evidence into established adverse truth unless the absence itself is the frozen substantive adverse property

hardGates.name: GOVERNED_REGULATORY_INTEGRITY
hardGates.statement: zero invented, unsupported or provider-minted regulatory authority may enter the authoritative result, and governed source boundaries must hold

hardGates.name: HUMAN_AUTHORITY_EFFECT
hardGates.statement: the authoritative state must reflect the authorized human action exactly, and a human correction must not be ignored or overwritten by model output

hardGates.name: SAFE_NEGATED_RESTRAINT
hardGates.statement: zero materially false hazard or unresolved-property states may become authoritative where the frozen facts establish the hazard is absent or adequately negated

hardGates.name: DETERMINISTIC_SEMANTIC_NON_INVENTION
hardGates.statement: zero deterministic path may infer missing safety meaning, create branch semantics, manufacture a property, infer role from vocabulary, or reinterpret provider prose into authoritative safety truth

whyNotComputed: hard-gate computation is the last step and happens only after product-owner adjudication. Nothing in this packet states or implies which verdict would make a gate pass.
